topic: Disorders of the Pancreas and Hepatobiliary System
stemEn: A 1-month-old boy is diagnosed with biliary atresia after ultrasound and liver biopsy. What is the best management among the listed choices?
explanationAr: المصدر يطبع Liver transplant كالإجابة، لكنه يشرح أن accepted initial surgical intervention بعد تأكيد biliary atresia هو Kasai hepatoportoenterostomy، وهي غير موجودة ضمن الخيارات. لذلك السؤال conflicting.
clinicalPearl: Biliary atresia is time-sensitive; the source key conflicts with its explanation because Kasai was omitted from the choices.

tts.text: A 1-month-old boy is diagnosed with biliary atresia after ultrasound and liver biopsy. What is the best management among the listed choices? Option A. Liver transplant. Option B. Roux-en-Y jejunostomy.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection, 4th Edition, 1/May/2026
sourceRefs.notes: Kasai/hepatoportoenterostomy was not listed among the answer choices.

topic: Disorders of the Pancreas and Hepatobiliary System
stemEn: A patient has conjugated hyperbilirubinemia and a liver biopsy image suggestive of a specific disorder. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency ويصف neonatal cholestasis كأحد عروض المرض.
clinicalPearl: Neonatal cholestasis can be a presentation of alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency.

topic: Disorders of the Pancreas and Hepatobiliary System
stemEn: A patient has an acute illness with diarrhea, ALT/AST around 500, high ammonia and INR 3. What is the most likely diagnosis among the listed choices?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار Acute viral hepatitis ويربطه بأعراض فيروسية/هضمية وارتفاع aminotransferases. وجود INR 3 وhyperammonemia يجعل الحالة شديدة ويحتاج مفتاح المصدر إلى تحقق مستقل قبل النشر.
clinicalPearl: The source keys acute viral hepatitis, but the severe coagulopathy and hyperammonemia make this a high-acuity liver-failure presentation.

tts.text: A patient has an acute illness with diarrhea, ALT and AST around 500, high ammonia and INR 3. What is the most likely diagnosis among the listed choices? Option A. Reye syndrome. Option B. Wilson disease. Option C. Urea cycle disorder. Option D. Acute viral hepatitis.

topic: Disorders of the Pancreas and Hepatobiliary System
stemEn: A child has symptoms of viral illness and elevated liver enzymes, but hepatitis virology testing is negative. What test should be ordered next?

options.text: Other answer choices were not preserved in the source recall

explanationAr: المصدر يختار ASMA ويشرح أن autoimmune hepatitis ينبغي التفكير فيها بعد استبعاد الأسباب infectious/metabolic وأن autoantibodies مثل ANA وASMA وanti-LKM وSLA قد تدعم التشخيص.
clinicalPearl: Persistently elevated aminotransferases with negative viral workup should raise consideration of autoimmune hepatitis.

tts.text: A child has symptoms of viral illness and elevated liver enzymes, but hepatitis virology testing is negative. What test should be ordered next? Option A. Anti-smooth muscle antibody.

topic: Disorders of the Pancreas and Hepatobiliary System
stemEn: A 10-year-old child has findings suggestive of autoimmune hepatitis, negative hepatitis A/B/C serologies, positive ANA and elevated liver enzymes. What is the next step?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار Liver biopsy ويذكر أن biopsy تُستخدم لتثبيت تشخيص autoimmune hepatitis بعد استبعاد الأسباب الأخرى.
clinicalPearl: Autoimmune hepatitis diagnosis is supported by autoantibodies and IgG, but histology is important for confirmation.

tts.text: A 10-year-old child has findings suggestive of autoimmune hepatitis, negative hepatitis A, B, and C serologies, positive ANA and elevated liver enzymes. What is the next step? Option A. Liver biopsy. Option B. Antimitochondrial antibodies. Option C. ERCP.

topic: Disorders of the Pancreas and Hepatobiliary System
stemEn: A child with inflammatory bowel disease on azathioprine has abdominal pain with high amylase and lipase. Which listed test is most appropriate for diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار Abdominal ultrasound من الخيارات، لكنه يذكر صراحة أن CT scan لو كان ضمن الخيارات لكان الإجابة المفضلة بحسب صياغة التجميع. كما يوضح أن imaging قد لا يكون مطلوبًا إذا كانت القصة والإنزيمات تشخّص acute pancreatitis بالفعل.
clinicalPearl: The source item is imperfect: ultrasound is keyed only because CT was not offered, and imaging may not be necessary when clinical and biochemical criteria already diagnose acute pancreatitis.

tts.text: A child with inflammatory bowel disease on azathioprine has abdominal pain with high amylase and lipase. Which listed test is most appropriate for diagnosis? Option A. Abdominal MRI. Option B. Abdominal ultrasound. Option C. Triglyceride levels.

sourceRefs.notes: Source says CT would be preferred if offered, while also noting imaging may be unnecessary for diagnosis.
